outcome: Neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratios (NLRs) in the first and third trimesters
cohort: 269 pregnant women (67 with FMF, 202 healthy controls) who underwent routine prenatal follow-up and delivery between 2016 and 2020
finding: Pregnant women with FMF had higher rates of preeclampsia and primary cesarean delivery compared to healthy controls, and both groups exhibited increased NLRs in the third trimester, with FMF patients having significantly higher NLRs than controls in the third trimester.
mod_finding: Women with FMF showed higher rates of primary cesarean delivery compared to healthy controls.
